intent.problem: PR #420 Hosted Linux failed because test_runner_preserves_cancellation_evidence looked for the word started in the log. run_quality_gate writes the full child command to that log before installing its signal handlers, and that command itself contains print('started'). On a fast Linux runner the test observes this false-ready marker and sends SIGTERM while the default handler is still active, so the wrapper exits -15 instead of recording and returning 143. Local macOS scheduling happened to install handlers first.
constraints: Preserve the predecessor archive and failed hosted run as immutable evidence.
Do not change production runner behavior without evidence of a production defect.
Keep strict assertions for cancellation result, timeout state, and exit code.
Use one documented adjacent recovery pair in a replacement PR.
Do not resume WI-10 until hosted CI, merge, closure, and branch cleanup complete.
intent.rationale: Making the child output marker absent from the command preamble means the relay can publish it only after handlers are installed. The test then synchronizes on the property it intends to verify and remains capable of catching real cancellation evidence loss.
